meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后,你让它把某个目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚才一起做的操作整理成一个可复用的技能,会生成或更新 .claude/skills/ 下的 SKILL.md 文件。它只靠读文件、查网页等现有工具完成,不引入额外引擎。
howto.when: 你说“/learn”、要它“把这个变成技能”“记住这个工作流”“从某个目录/网址做技能”,或要改进已有技能时触发。它能新建技能,也能更新已存在的技能。

say.text: /learn 这个目录,把里面的工作流做成技能
say.note: 它会读目录,生成对应 SKILL.md

say.text: 把刚才我们做的操作整理成技能
say.note: 它回看对话并提炼可重复步骤

say.text: 更新一下 my-setup 技能
say.note: 它读取现有 SKILL.md 并就地改进

howto.what_en: When asked, it turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or recent work into a reusable skill by creating or updating .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. It works only with existing tools like Read, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, and Write — no separate engine.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases such as "/learn", "learn this", "turn this into a skill", "capture this workflow", "make a skill from <source>", or "improve/update the <name> skill". It can create new skills or refine existing ones.

say_en.text: /learn this directory and turn its workflow into a skill.
say_en.note: It reads the folder and writes a SKILL.md.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did into a skill.
say_en.note: It reviews the conversation and extracts steps.
It reads the existing SKILL.md and improves it.
